I’m Dhruv, a computer science student at BITS Pilani, Goa. I focus on distributed systems and backend architecture. I’m drawn to the details behind the scenes: the systems that make everything else work.

My projects explore background task processing, developer tools, and multiplayer networking—one idea at a time.
